items.text: Hello community!

We wanted to thank you for your engagement and all the valuable feedback regarding the game. Over the past few weeks, we've collected your comments and worked on enhancing your experience with Go Fight Fantastic!
The new patch eliminates a bunch of critical bugs, visual glitches, and runtime errors, introduces improvements in the UI and quality of life, as well as gameplay balancing.
We hope that these changes will allow you to enjoy the game even more.
The new patch addresses a total of 68 issues - bug removals and improvements - including:
Meteorite balancing.
Boss balancing
It should no longer be able to stand inside of Froggy boss in Chapter 1
The bombardment in Mausoleum (mid-event in Chapter 2) is now activated on an interval instead of being activated by collider.
Players can now switch characters with keyboard by pressing 1-3, switching to the character corresponding to the character roster created at character selection.
Implemented multi-actor conversations, giving the resistance members in Chapter 2 a dialog between themselves.
Fixed multiple occurrences of visual glitches/bugs where environmental objects rendered in front of the player when it shouldn’t
Fixed game critical bug where the player would die of poison and would no longer be able to be revived.
Fixed a possibility to get enormous scores in score screen upon death in Story Mode and Horde Mode
Fixed an issue where the players would end up at the wrong position after a cutscene.
Fixed several runtime errors.
Issue where archers dash got activated in chunk transitions, causing both visual VFX to spawn and meteorite effects to be triggered
You can now purchase Zev's doll in the shop.
Issue where talking to Wicky in Chapter 6 caused a runtime error which made the character stuck until it pressed the talk button again.
Horde Mode High Score list can now be scrolled with a controller
Improvements to the Meteorite Station/Forge UI
Improvements to cutscene dialogue, adding both an initial delay to progressing the first conversation to avoid accidental first skip,
The End nameplate now render above the portraits, so the portrait don’t blocks her nameplate anymore
Improvements to settings UI
Store now animates skins in the preview window.
Fixed bug with Jukebox where it would display multiple songs as possible to be paused, as if they were all playing at the same time
Fixed some minor mistakes in the Ships Log archives

topNew: Implemented multi-actor conversations, giving the resistance members in Chapter 2 a dialog between themselves.

items.text: Thank you everyone for all your amazing feedback and words of encouragement. It really means a lot to us and truly helps us make the game better.

We have continued our efforts with improving the Online Multiplayer, which is now overall MUCH more stable. We’re incredibly proud of the team efforts and happy to have been able to now push 4 major stability patches in 3 weeks, resolving most issues.
We’ve also focused on improving gameplay-features and user experience based on community feedback, such as the new Meteorite Sorting-feature.

As always, don’t forget to leave us a good review if you like the game. We’re always incredibly thankful for any help in boosting our reach, letting more people know about the game and hopefully trying it out!
Online Multiplayer
Overall Online Multiplayer is MUCH more stable now!
You can now join a Steam invite even if you don’t have the game running!
Meteorites Cross contaminating between players improved further, should fix issues with characters sometimes being prevented from picking up healing orbs.
Character Abilities going into full lockdown should no longer happen.
Characters getting attack aim-direction lockdowns with Keyboard/Mouse-controls.
Ability Aim direction issues caused overall – and those caused by Host input fixed.
Spawning out of bounds in Lobby.
T3 Heavy and Chapter 3 boss attack visualizers should now behave on client sides (no more permanent red rings).
Leaving a session could previously leave the character portrait from the old player in the corner UI.
Players getting stuck in a specific spot in Chapter 6: Stasis Chambers.
All enemy Death VFX now visible and in sync on host and clients alike.
A bunch of minor desync-issues and intermittent RPC-call errors fixed.
Fixed Pet-the-dog-issues, when host and client have different progressions unlocked.
You can now SORT your meteorite collection by NAME, RARITY and LEVEL.
Horde Mode wave spawning improved to make more waves before clearing a stage.
Horde Mode powerup “Maxed Out” text now showing again (localization issue).
Horde Mode now show visible coin and shard counters (minor UX improvement)
Mercury Arrow and Dash-attacks visuals and responsiveness improvements.
Mercury’s Blood Bombs should now respect walls and blockers - and not fly through.
Enemy Buff Towers are now included in Mercury’s Aim Assist for Arrows.
Chapter 2 Grass-volume increased to give better cover from Drones.
Chapter 5 Boss now shows spawn markers when calling in reinforcements.
Chapter 5 Boss HP-bars improved for increased contrast and readability.
Carpet Decoration in Lobby now swapping carpets as it should.
Some Ship’s Log entries sometimes wouldn’t unlock as intended (Zev/Poi/Empress)
Unlocking New Game+ now means you need to manually pick a chapter for replay.
Meteorite Fire Strike’s fireball-direction fixed.
Wildfire Meteorite now shouldn’t be able to kill players in lobby.
Starguard Meteorite fixed Mercury Leap issue (allowing her to dash across the world)
Meteorites (such as Spirit Lotus) descriptions showing zero and zero heal, now fixed.
Assassinate Meteorite Kill Effect-bonus is now actually temporary.
Pyromaniac Meteorite Critical Hit Chance-bonus is now actually temporary.
Fixed some localization issues (some Swedish dev-notes hiding in the game).

If you have any specific issues that you would like us to give extra attention, please let us know in the Discord and we’ll do our best to include it in the next patch: https://discord.gg/gofightfantastic
And with that, we wish you all a FANTASTIC day!

Thanks to the hard work of everyone in our small team here at Dinomite, we’ve been testing and fixing issues relentlessly - and are happy to report we’ve now been able to fix over 150 Online Multiplayer related issues in the two weeks since first launching the game – along with other gameplay related issues. This means that things are starting to look MUCH more stable!
There’s still work to be done, so we will continue to fix issues and patch the game as quickly as we can.

Thank you for all the great feedback and encouragement. It really means a lot to us, as we’re trying our best to make the game as awesome as possible. If you like the game, don’t forget to leave a positive review!
Returning from Chapter 1 would sometimes result in a Black Screen.
Returning to Lobby could sometimes cause Clients to get stuck seeing out of bounds content with game thinking they’re in a cutscene when they’re not.
Hosts could affect Client’s facing and ability/attack direction.
Players could get trapped in Chapter 6 after selecting Try Again on Game Over-screen.
Players could desync going into new chunks/areas, leaving one player behind.
Archer (Mercury’s) Dashes could misbehave and travel in the wrong direction.
Empty Steam Invites/Lobbies now expire and get removed when empty.
Meteorite Drops (including Boss Drops) could fly through walls, beyond reach.
Clients could sometimes see false Boss Drops.
When one player upgraded a Meteorite in the Forge, all players would get the upgrade.
Hosts force-closing the game (Alt-F4) now return clients to Title Screen.
Fixed a bunch of minor errors that were thrown: Misc RPC-calls, Null Refs, Index out of range, etc.
Player Attack UI/HUD could sometimes get hidden/disabled in Ship Lobby.
Boss Poi’s Drone Strikes are now working as intended again.
Clients would not see Epilogue and End Credits after clearing the last chapter for the first time.
Final Boss could leave combat area if Host was downed.
Archer (Mercury) could get stuck in walls when dashing.
Chapter 2 could sometimes spawn VERY high-level enemies reserved for New Game+.
Enemy Buff Towers now shows an icon to indicate function: Life Steal, HP Regeneration, etc.).
Boss Poi’s Chain Lightning-attack removed due to confusing UX/behavior.
The Meteorite Forge had invisible elements covering meteorite collection, preventing interactions.
Horde Mode Score Screen no longer incorrectly reports playing a specific chapter.
Minor re-balancing of Chapter 6 enemies and Boss-fight.
Minor Localization fixes for Status Effects, Horde Mode, etc.

If you have any issues that you would like us to give extra attention to, please let us know in the Discord and we’ll do our best to include them in the next patch: Official Go Fight Fantastic! Discord Channel
And with that, we wish you all a FANTASTIC day!

Our main focus for this patch has been the stability of input (keyboard/mouse/controller) and the online multiplayer, so the team has been trying to hammer out as many bugs as possible! This is a fairly big patch with a lot of fixes, so hopefully, everyone will have a much better experience after this patch.
We’re still working on the remaining issues and want to get patches out as quickly as possible, so the next one will hopefully be out on Wednesday.
Thank you to everyone who has been helping us by reporting your issues! Knowing they exist makes it much easier for us to find and fix the bugs!
Input/Controls
Fixed all cases we could find where the game loses connection with keyboard/mouse or Controller(s). If you still encounter errors, restarting game should fix it.
Should now work much better with Alt-Tabbing in and out of the game.
Should also work much better when Shift-Tabbing in and out of the game to invite friends to Online Multiplayer.
Low Level Input Device issues (connecting a controller, false hardware disconnects, etc)
Couch Co-Op now has indicators to clarify the need for 3 separate controllers (can’t be played with a mix of controllers and keyboard – or 3 players on the same keyboard).
Overall, A LOT of De-sync and Stability fixes (should be much smoother now)
Fixed game sometimes soft locking on Character Selection.
Fixed Blockers after defeating bosses (Poi and Zev).
Characters spawning or dashing out of bounds in Story Mode.
Tank and Striker abilities sometimes causing complete lockdown, making them unable to attack, take damage, etc.
Navigation visuals (arrows and button icons) restored on Character Selection
Character Skins is now working in Online Multiplayer – and should now be shown in Cutscenes.
Clients no longer unlock all chapters after clearing a single chapter.
UI Improvements for Connectivity, making it easier to host and see when players connect to your session, plus better interaction with Invite vs Matchmaking popup.
De-sync Issues with enemies showing on client but not host, having seemingly 0 HP but still being alive, etc.
Finding Music Discs no longer causes major desync events after.
Accepting Invites / Joining a Friend’s game can now be done from anywhere (even if you’re in the middle of another session – or playing solo or couch co-op).
Misc Cutscene Desync issues (getting incorrect cutscenes after chapters, etc).
Meteorite Upgrades could previously cross-contaminate between players and their unused but equipped characters, causing strange effects and desyncs.
Fixed a bunch of minor things throwing/logging errors, such as the Swamp Monsters on Chapter 3, Cutscenes, etc.
Ending a session should now return all players to the Start/Title Screen.
All Achievements tested and verified working including problematic:
“Song Bird” Achievement (Talk to all NPCs in game).
“Space Curtains” (Beat Final Boss on Nightmare difficulty).
“Music Lover” (Find all Music for the Jukebox).
“Invincible” (Reach Stage 10 without getting downed).
“Go Fight Fantastic!” (Defeat the Final Boss).
HP should no longer reset, causing you to lose accumulated Health Powerups.
Powerup Re-balancing trying to remove as many limits as possible.
T3 Spider Eggs now count as enemies (so you don’t get attacked by spiders during Powerup Selection).
Rebalanced Enemy count in some areas that were a bit overwhelming.
Minor Cutscene fixes (incorrect portraits for some characters)
Minor visual fixes on Chapter 5 and 6 with foreground occlusions and VFX layers.
Going between Jukebox and Character Selection could result in multiple music tracks playing on top of each other.
Horde Mode-music should no longer turn off if you cleared a Story Mode Chapter before playing Horde Mode.
Skipping Cutscenes should no longer result in Boss Music sometimes vanishing.
Ship/Lobby should always have music playing now.
Night Club music is now working.
Misc flow fixes for stability.
Minor fixes for Simplified Chinese (missing translations found).
Archer Basic Attack (Arrow) responsiveness improved after Dashing.
Decorations now auto-activate on purchase (previously had to buy, then activate).

Returning from a Chapter in Story Mode, you may get a black screen (with visible HUD). You can still move around and interact with things behind this black screen – and you can Press Enter/LT to ready up for the next chapter. Restarting the session with fix issue.

Having meteorites equipped to the four characters in Solo, may cause issues in Online. We recommend all players unequip all Meteorites in solo (for all characters) before going into Online Multiplayer Sessions until completely fixed!
Playing Mercury as Player 2 or 3 in Online Multiplayer (not the host) may cause Dash to misbehave.
Striker and Archer can dash/teleport through some wall-colliders and geometry (which can make them get stuck in colliders). But can usually dash/teleport back.
Chapter 2 may spawn very high tier enemies when it shouldn’t.
Mission Debriefing Cutscenes may still be out of order, which may cause chapters to unlock out of order.
If you still encounter errors with things that are marked as fixed, please let us know so we can re-open the issue for the next patch! You can reach us directly on Go Fight Fantastic! Discord Channel

notes.title: Hello everyone! We now have our first patch up and running!

items.text: It’s been a very intense first week, but we’re thrilled to finally be able to share the game with everyone!

Thank you for all the great feedback. We’re trying to fix as many problems as possible, so there will be another patch next week with more fixes. To everyone playing the game from China, we want to apologize for all the issues you’ve been seeing with Online Multiplayer and assure you we’re working on as many fixes as possible specifically for your region. Hopefully, this patch will remedy a lot of the issues you’ve been seeing.
Major fixes for Online Multiplayer. With Steam, friend invites now working more fluently and being more accessible.
Fixes for Online Multiplayer for China specifically – both friend-invites and matchmaking should now work much better. More fixes coming in next patch!
Horde Mode leaderboards are now fixed and should no longer reset scores.
Meteorite loadout getting locked in, without any way of unequipping.
Bugfixes for the Poi & Zev Boss Fights.
Invisible chests fixed!
Chinese Localization fixes and polish.
Overall balancing and Stability.
Know issues: (fixes coming soon)
The Tier-3 (T3) Assassins may deal infinite damage and instantly kill the players.
Healing orbs may get stuck in Online Multiplayer and can’t be absorbed. May be resolved by restarting the game.
Some damage doesn’t count towards the score screen.
Froggy deals too much damage if standing too close when he makes his ring attack on Hard+. It can accidentally insta-kill characters.
Ready Plate in Lobby may be missing in some instances, but ready up still functions. (Press: ENTER on keyboard, LT/L2 on controller to ready up!)
HP and maybe other powerups can randomly reset in the Horde Mode.
Online Multiplayer desyncs, we’re fixing as many as we can as quickly as possible. May be fixed by party disconnecting/rebooting game and reconnecting.
Some achievements may not trigger as they are supposed to.
Love, the Dinomite Team!
